name: RadioGroup
summary: One choice among a few visible options: round controls with labels under a legend, with an optional description and error.
useWhen: One choice among two to six options that people should see side by side before they pick
A setting where the options need a line of explanation each
A required question in a form where no answer is picked yet
avoidWhen: Seven or more options, or a list that grows
A single yes or no setting
Options that need a title, text and an icon in a card

label.description: The visible question, rendered as the legend and used as the group name.

description.description: A hint for the whole group. Joins aria-describedby. On RadioGroupItem, a line of help under that option.

error.description: What is wrong and how to fix it. While it shows, the group is invalid.

invalid.description: Marks the group invalid. When not passed, the group is invalid while it shows an error. false hides the error.

defaultValue.description: The checked value at first render. No default: a group starts with none checked.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value when a person picks an option.

disabled.description: Disables every option. On RadioGroupItem, that option only.

required.description: Shows the required mark on the legend and sets aria-required.

name.description: The form field name of the hidden native inputs.

orientation.description: vertical: one option per line. horizontal: options on one line that wraps.

size.description: Circle 14, 16 and 20 px. Every circle sits in a press area of at least 24px; lg rows are 44px.

tone.description: neutral: the checked circle takes the text color. accent: the primary fill, yellow in Desk.

loop.description: Arrow keys wrap from the last option to the first.

a11y.role: radiogroup on the root, named by the legend; radio on each control, named by its label
a11y.focus: One tab stop for the group. Tab lands on the checked option, or the first enabled option when none is checked. Focus shows a 2px ring around the circle.

keys.Tab: Moves focus into the group at the checked option, and on to the next control
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves focus back out of the group
keys.ArrowDown: Moves to the next option and selects it
keys.ArrowUp: Moves to the previous option and selects it
keys.ArrowRight, ArrowLeft: Move to the option on that side and select it, in either orientation. They follow the reading direction: in Arabic ArrowLeft moves to the next option.
keys.Space: Selects the focused option when it is not checked

a11y.announce: The group name from the legend, the group description and error through aria-describedby, aria-invalid and aria-required on the group. Each option is read with its label, its description, its checked state and its position, for example 2 of 3.
notes: Behavior from Radix RadioGroup. Each control is a button with role radio; a hidden native input per option posts the value with the form.
Enter does not select, as in a native radio group. Enter submits the form.
Disabled uses native disabled, as for text entry: a disabled option leaves the arrow order and draws with opacity.disabled.
Read only does not apply: show the chosen value as text instead.
The 16px circle sits in a 24px press area (WCAG 2.5.8): the hover veil is that area, and the label is bound to the control, so the text extends it.
The checked state is a filled circle with a dot, never color alone. Invalid adds the danger border to the unchecked circles and an error with an icon.
The error is not a live region. On submit, move focus to the checked option or the first option.
data-invalid is on the root and on each item; the unchecked circles take the danger border.

Motion, round 3 (radio-pop, proposed): the checked fill, an inset box-shadow, closes from the border to the dot, which springs in from the side of the old option while the old dot shrinks and leaves toward the new one, one move along the group. Reduced motion: the fill and the dot change at once.

Order 1.29: the option a change leaves drops its fill at once, so two options never look chosen. Hooks for styles: --_radio-group-radius (the circle, its ring and its veil) and --_radio-group-dot-radius, radius.pill by default.

en.legend: A short question or a noun in sentence case: Who can comment, Billing period.
en.label: Short, parallel and in sentence case. Start with the word that tells options apart. No end punctuation.
en.description: One line that helps choose: what the option means or costs.
en.error: Say what to do: Pick a billing period, so we can show the price.
en.order: A natural order (smallest to largest, most common first). Preselect the safe default when there is one.

ar.legend: سؤال قصير أو اسم بدون تشكيل: صلاحية التعليق، فترة الفوترة
ar.label: قصيرة ومتوازية، بصيغة الاسم وبدون تشكيل
ar.description: سطر واحد يوضح الفرق بين الخيارات
ar.error: قل وش المطلوب: اختر فترة الفوترة عشان نعرض لك السعر

angular.behavior: div[dsRadioGroup] and div[dsRadioGroupItem], hand built with the Radix RadioGroup DOM on the CDK FocusKeyManager and Directionality, ControlValueAccessor
angular.note: The group host is the root (role radiogroup), the item host is the item row. Inputs take the React prop names; onValueChange is the valueChange output of [(value)]. label, description and error take text. aria-labelledby and aria-describedby are inputs on the group (React merges them with its own ids); id, aria-label, aria-labelledby and aria-describedby are inputs on the item (React spreads them on the control). Behavior by hand in behavior/roving-radio.ts with the Radix DOM: the root is the tab stop and hands focus to the checked item, arrows move and select in the reading direction (key moves on the CDK FocusKeyManager), Space selects, Enter does nothing, Shift+Tab leaves the group, a hidden native radio after each control inside a form. Works with reactive and template forms. RadioGroup.css is used as is.

styles.studio: A transparent circle with the control border; checked fills it with the text color and a dot in the body color. accent uses the translucent primary fill with the control border and a dot in the text color.
styles.desk: The same circle in Instrument Sans; accent fills it with the yellow primary and a dark dot, with the primary border (dark gold in light) and the doubled focus ring.

mistakes.wrong: A RadioGroup with one option, to ask for a yes or no
mistakes.right: A Checkbox, or a Switch for a setting that applies at once

mistakes.wrong: Options without a legend, named only by the heading above
mistakes.right: label on the RadioGroup, so the group has a name

mistakes.wrong: Red labels to show the group is invalid
mistakes.right: error on the RadioGroup: the message with an icon says what to do

mistakes.wrong: Options that change the page at once, like tabs
